say.en: The screen shows the groups of 2,60,000: 2 lakh, 60 thousand, and the rest, 000. A comma is a wall between places: after 3 digits from the right the thousands start, after 2 more the lakhs. A comma goes only where a new name starts.

simpler.hi: Comma wahin lagta hai jahan naya naam shuru ho. 2,60,000 mein 2 lakh aur 60 hazaar hain.
simpler.en: A comma goes only where a new name starts. 2,60,000 has 2 lakh and 60 thousand.

prompt.hi: Paanch lakh das hazaar ko numerals mein Indian commas ke saath likho.
prompt.en: Write five lakh ten thousand in numerals with Indian commas.

why.hi: 5 lakh ka ank hai, hazaar ka group 10 hai, aur baaki 000, toh 5,10,000 banta hai
why.en: 5 goes in the lakhs, the thousands group is 10, and the rest is 000, so it makes 5,10,000

simpler.hi: Pehle lakh ka ank likho, phir das hazaar ke do ank. Sau, dahai aur ikai khaali hain, wahan zero rakho aur Indian commas lagao.
simpler.en: First write the lakh digit, then the two digits of ten thousand. The hundreds, tens and ones are empty, so put zeros there and add Indian commas.

bridgeToNext.hi: Ab commas se bada number padhna aata hai. Agle hisse mein do bade numbers milayenge aur dekhenge ki kaun bada hai.
bridgeToNext.en: Now you can read a big number by its commas. Next we put two big numbers side by side and see which is bigger.

simpler.hi: Commas se bada number padhna aa gaya. Agle hisse mein do bade numbers ki tulna karenge.
simpler.en: You can read a big number by its commas now. Next we compare two big numbers.

hook.convey: two big counts side by side; the one starting with 9 is not always bigger → count digits first; same digits → compare from the leftmost place

use.hi: Ek cricket match mein 98,000 log aaye, doosre mein 1,05,000. Pehla number 9 se shuru hota hai, phir bhi doosre match mein zyada log the. Aaj iska kaaran dekhenge.
use.en: One cricket match drew 98,000 people, another 1,05,000. The first number starts with 9, yet the second match had more people. Today we see why.

use.hi: Do trucks ne saal mein 87,500 km aur 1,12,000 km chalaye. Kis truck ne zyada chalaya, yeh ankon ko gin kar turant pata chal jaata hai.
use.en: Two trucks ran 87,500 km and 1,12,000 km in a year. Which truck ran more, you can tell at once by counting the digits.

explain.convey: more digits → bigger number, whatever the first digit; a 6-digit number beats every 5-digit number

point.hi: 96,500 mein paanch ank hain, 2,04,000 mein chhah ank. Jismein zyada ank hon, woh bada hota hai, chahe uska pehla ank chhota ho.
point.en: 96,500 has five digits, 2,04,000 has six digits. The one with more digits is bigger, even if its first digit is smaller.

prompt.hi: Isi tarah ank gino. Kaun bada hai: 89,000 ya 1,10,000?
prompt.en: Count the digits the same way. Which is bigger: 89,000 or 1,10,000?

why.hi: 89,000 paanch ank ka chhota number hai, aur 1,10,000 chhah ank ka bada
why.en: 89,000 has five digits and is smaller, and 1,10,000 has six and is bigger

simpler.hi: 96,500 mein paanch ank hain, 2,04,000 mein chhah. Jis number mein zyada ank hon, wahi bada hota hai.
simpler.en: 96,500 has five digits and 2,04,000 has six. The number with more digits is the bigger one.

explain.convey: same number of digits → line them up and compare from the leftmost place; the first place that differs decides, the rest do not matter

point.hi: 3,57,200 aur 3,75,100, dono mein chhah ank hain. Left se milao: lakh mein dono ka 3. Das-hazaar mein 5 aur 7, aur 7 bada hai, toh 3,75,100 bada hai. Baaki ank dekhne ki zaroorat nahi.
point.en: 3,57,200 and 3,75,100 both have six digits. Compare from the left: in the lakhs both have 3. In the ten thousands, 5 and 7, and 7 is bigger, so 3,75,100 is bigger. No need to look at the other digits.

prompt.hi: Isi tarah left se milao. Kaun bada hai: 64,280 ya 64,820?
prompt.en: Compare from the left the same way. Which is bigger: 64,280 or 64,820?

why.hi: dono mein 64 hazaar barabar hain, aur pehli baar alag sau mein: 8, 2 se bada, toh 64,820 bada
why.en: both have 64 thousand, and the first place that differs is hundreds: 8 beats 2, so 64,820 is bigger

simpler.hi: Dono numbers ko left se ek-ek ank milao. Jahan pehli baar ank alag ho, wahan jiska ank bada, wahi number bada.
simpler.en: Match the two numbers digit by digit from the left. Where the digits first differ, the one with the bigger digit is the bigger number.

problem.hi: Teen trains ne ek saal mein itni doori tay ki: Train A ne 2,48,600 km, Train B ne 2,84,060 km, aur Train C ne 98,750 km. Inhe bade se chhote ke kram mein lagao.
problem.en: Three trains ran these distances in a year: Train A 2,48,600 km, Train B 2,84,060 km, and Train C 98,750 km. Arrange them from biggest to smallest.

simpler.hi: Pehle dekho kis number mein sabse kam ank hain. Baaki do mein lakh ka ank ek jaisa hai, toh das-hazaar ka ank milao.
simpler.en: First see which number has the fewest digits. The other two have the same lakhs digit, so compare the ten-thousands digit.

givens.en: A ran 2,48,600 km, B ran 2,84,060 km

find.hi: teeno dooriyan bade se chhote ke kram mein
find.en: the three distances from biggest to smallest

do.en: Count the digits in all three distances

steps.result: A mein chhah, B mein chhah, C mein paanch ank, toh C sabse chhota

why.hi: kam ankon wala number chhota hota hai
why.en: the number with fewer digits is smaller

simpler.hi: 2,48,600 aur 2,84,060 mein chhah ank hain, 98,750 mein sirf paanch. Kam ank wala number chhota hota hai, toh C sabse chhota.
simpler.en: 2,48,600 and 2,84,060 have six digits, 98,750 has only five. The number with fewer digits is smaller, so C is the smallest.

do.hi: A aur B ka lakh ka ank milao
do.en: Compare the lakhs digit of A and B

why.hi: lakh barabar ho toh agla khaana dekhna padta hai
why.en: when the lakhs are equal we look at the next place

simpler.hi: A aur B dono ka lakh ka ank 2 hai. Dono barabar hain, toh agle khaane pe jaana padega.
simpler.en: A and B both have 2 in the lakhs place. They are equal, so we must go to the next place.

prompt.hi: Ab dono chhah-ank wali dooriyon ka das-hazaar ka ank milao. Sabse zyada doori kis train ki hai?
prompt.en: Now compare the ten thousands digit of the two six-digit distances. Which train ran the farthest?

simpler.hi: Ab das-hazaar ka ank dekho, yaani lakh ke theek baad wala ank. Jis doori ka yeh ank bada ho, wahi train sabse door gayi.
simpler.en: Now look at the ten thousands digit, the one just after the lakhs. The distance with the bigger digit there is the train that went farthest.

why.hi: A 2,48,600 aur B 2,84,060 mein das-hazaar ka 8, 4 se bada, aur C 98,750 chhota hai
why.en: of A 2,48,600 and B 2,84,060, B's ten thousands digit 8 beats 4, and C 98,750 is smaller

answer.hi: kram hai B 2,84,060 km, A 2,48,600 km, phir C 98,750 km
answer.en: the order is B 2,84,060 km, A 2,48,600 km, then C 98,750 km

why.hi: A 2,48,600 aur B 2,84,060 mein das-hazaar ka 8, 4 se bada, aur C 98,750 chhota hai
why.en: of A 2,48,600 and B 2,84,060, B's ten thousands digit 8 beats 4, and C 98,750 is smaller

prompt.hi: Pehla shehar: 89,500 log. Doosra shehar: 1,12,000 log. Kis shehar mein zyada log hain: pehle mein ya doosre mein?
prompt.en: First town: 89,500 people. Second town: 1,12,000 people. Which town has more people: the first or the second?

why.hi: doosra shehar 1,12,000 chhah ank ka hai, aur pehla shehar 89,500 sirf paanch ank ka
why.en: the second town's 1,12,000 has six digits, and the first town's 89,500 only five

simpler.hi: Dono numbers ke ank gino, 89,500 mein paanch ank hain. Jis number mein zyada ank hon, us shehar mein zyada log hain.
simpler.en: Count the digits of both numbers; 89,500 has five digits. The town whose number has more digits has more people.

prompt.hi: Pehla gaana: 4,35,000 views. Doosra gaana: 4,53,000 views. Kis gaane ko zyada views mile: pehle ko ya doosre ko?
prompt.en: First song: 4,35,000 views. Second song: 4,53,000 views. Which song got more views: the first or the second?

why.hi: pehla gaana 4,35,000 aur doosra 4,53,000; lakh mein dono 4, par das-hazaar mein 5, 3 se bada hai
why.en: the first song 4,35,000 and the second 4,53,000 both have 4 lakhs, but in ten thousands 5 is bigger than 3

simpler.hi: Dono numbers mein lakh ka ank barabar hai. Ab agla khaana, yaani das-hazaar ka ank milao.
simpler.en: Both numbers have the same lakh digit. Now match the next place, the ten thousands digit.

prompt.hi: Truck X ne 1,08,000 km chalaya, Truck Y ne 96,000 km, aur Truck Z ne 1,80,000 km. Sabse kam kis truck ne chalaya: X, Y ya Z?
prompt.en: Truck X ran 1,08,000 km, Truck Y 96,000 km, and Truck Z 1,80,000 km. Which truck ran the least: X, Y or Z?

why.hi: truck Y ke 96,000 mein sirf paanch ank hain, aur X 1,08,000 aur Z 1,80,000 mein chhah
why.en: truck Y's 96,000 has only five digits, while X's 1,08,000 and Z's 1,80,000 have six

simpler.hi: Pehle teeno dooriyon ke ank gino. Jis number mein sabse kam ank hon, wahi sabse chhota hai.
simpler.en: First count the digits of all three distances. The number with the fewest digits is the smallest.

ladder.why: 98,765 against 1,02,345 → predict by digit count alone, the first-digit trap head on
stadium crowds 1,32,000 and 68,000 → 6 digits against 5 in a story, and say how you knew
order three numbers → digit count, then same digits compared from the left (6 hundreds against 0)
₹1,05,000 against ₹99,500 → which is more, then by how much across one lakh
three 6-digit amounts with the same lakh → left-to-right place by place, second largest

remediation.move: both numbers right-aligned in one chart, ones under ones; find the first place where only one number has a digit; that place decides, not the first digit

say.hi: Screen par 9,876 aur 12,345 hain. Dono ko right se, ikai ke neeche ikai rakho: 9,876 mein chaar ank hain, 12,345 mein paanch ank. 12,345 ke das-hazaar wale khaane mein ank hai aur 9,876 ka wahan kuch nahi, isliye 12,345 bada hai.
say.en: On the screen are 9,876 and 12,345. Line them up from the right, ones under ones: 9,876 has four digits, 12,345 has five digits. 12,345 has a digit in the ten thousands place and 9,876 has nothing there, so 12,345 is bigger.

simpler.hi: 12,345 mein paanch ank hain, 9,876 mein sirf chaar. 12,345 ka das-hazaar wala khaana bhara hai, isliye 12,345 bada hai.
simpler.en: 12,345 has five digits and 9,876 only four. 12,345 has a ten thousands digit, so 12,345 is bigger.

prompt.hi: Pehla mela: 87,000 log. Doosra mela: 1,02,000 log. Zyada log kis mele mein aaye: pehle ya doosre?
prompt.en: First fair: 87,000 people. Second fair: 1,02,000 people. Which fair had more people: the first or the second?

why.hi: doosra mela 1,02,000 chhah ank ka hai, aur pehla mela 87,000 sirf paanch ank ka
why.en: the second fair's 1,02,000 has six digits, and the first fair's 87,000 only five

simpler.hi: 87,000 mein paanch ank hain aur 1,02,000 mein chhah. Jis number mein zyada ank hon, woh bada hota hai.
simpler.en: 87,000 has five digits and 1,02,000 has six. The number with more digits is bigger.
